body:
> There is always a hitsperpage either explicitly or implicitly so we can't just choose a value in the list provided by the user... So I would that this solution will lead to inconsistency. The best we can do is update the value from the results of the search.

Even if you have a value in the index settings (so "implicitly" defined), what you want is to drive the number of hits per page with the values from the select because that's how you've designed your UI: I think @pixelastic's proposition is OK.
